title: Reduce to a summary
summary: A reduction combines values into a summary, such as a sum or mean.
introduction: A reduction combines values into a summary, such as a sum or mean. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A reduction combines values into a summary, such as a sum or mean.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

x = tf.constant([2.0, 4.0, 6.0])
print(float(tf.reduce_mean(x).numpy()))
blocks.title: Reduce to a summary

blocks.text: The result is 4.0. The three values sum to 12 and there are three of them.
